newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF, Siemens in JV talks.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF, Siemens in JV talks.

text.p: Thomson-CSF said its Thomson-CSF Airsys was in talks with Siemens AG to set up a joint-venture company for air traffic management (ATM) in which Thomson-CSF would have a majority stake.

In a statement, Thomson-CSF said the proposed joint venture would leverage the partner's combined ATM expertise by establishing a single organisation with premises in France, United Kingdom, Germany, Australia and the United States.
Thomson-CSF Airsys has annual revenues in air traffic management of 1.4 billion francs.
